evidence: extensive COPY statements typical of ORCA

purpose.domain_detail: Japanese medical receipt (レセプト) creation and print instruction system for JMA ORCA medical billing software
purpose.summary: ORCGR02 is a batch program in the JMA ORCA medical receipt system that handles receipt (レセプト) creation and print instruction processing. It manages print ordering, job control DB, receipt management files, and supports various print modes including preview, reprint, and inpatient/outpatient distinctions. The program coordinates with multiple subprograms via CALL and COPY-based data structures.

notable_features: 48 COPY statements indicating heavy use of shared copybooks
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS
Fixed-format source with some lines over 72 chars
Japanese EUC-encoded comments (latin-1 decoded with mojibake)
Extensive working-storage with structured parameter areas
verdict.notes: Source is truncated at 16000 chars out of 247546 bytes (5526 lines total). Comments are in Japanese EUC encoding, decoded as latin-1 resulting in mojibake display. The program is clearly part of the well-known open-source JMA ORCA medical receipt system. No COMP-3 usage detected despite being a substantial production program, consistent with GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL ORCA codebase style.
